--******************DML OPERATIONS CANT PERFORM ON EXTERNAL TABLE*************

--small table sathi we used ll table

CREATE TABLE dbo.TS
(
    STUDYID     VARCHAR(200),
    DOMAIN      VARCHAR(200),
    TSPARMCD    VARCHAR(200),
    TSPARM      VARCHAR(200),
    TSVAL       VARCHAR(200),
    MODIFIED_TS VARCHAR(200)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
);


COPY INTO [dbo].[ts] 
FROM 'https://stsynapsedev1999.blob.core.windows.net/synapse-file/clintrail_data_files/TS/TS.csv'
WITH (
    FIELDTERMINATOR = ',',
    ROWTERMINATOR = '0x0A'
)
OPTION (LABEL = 'COPY: dbo.TS');


SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TS;

DBCC PDW_SHOWSPACEUSED('dbo.TS')

CREATE TABLE dbo.LB
(
    STUDYID     VARCHAR(200),
    DOMAIN      VARCHAR(200),
    USUBJID     VARCHAR(200),
    LBSEQ       VARCHAR(200),
    LBTESTCD    VARCHAR(200),
    LBTEST      VARCHAR(200),
    LBCAT       VARCHAR(200),
    LBORRES     VARCHAR(200),
    LBORRESU    VARCHAR(200),
    LBORNRLO    VARCHAR(200),
    LBORNRHI    VARCHAR(200),
    LBNRIND     VARCHAR(200),
    VISITNUM    VARCHAR(200),
    VISIT       VARCHAR(200),
    LBDTC       VARCHAR(200),
    MODIFIED_TS VARCHAR(200)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
);


COPY INTO [dbo].[lb] 
FROM 'https://stsynapsedev1999.blob.core.windows.net/synapse-file/clintrail_data_files/LB/LB.csv'
WITH (
    FIELDTERMINATOR = ',',
    ROWTERMINATOR = '0x0A'
)
OPTION (LABEL = 'COPY: dbo.LB');


SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LB;

DBCC PDW_SHOWSPACEUSED('dbo.LB')

-- How to distribute the data across the compute node
-- DISTRIBUTION Types
-- 1. HASH KEY --- We need to specify the column=assured us same data will be in the same compute 
-- 2. ROUND_ROBIN==
-- 3. REPLICATE
--CRAETE TABLE FOR HASH KEY
CREATE TABLE dbo.VS
(
    STUDYID VARCHAR(200),
    DOMAIN VARCHAR(200),
    USUBJID VARCHAR(200),
    VSSEQ VARCHAR(200),
    VSTESTCD VARCHAR(200),
    VSTEST VARCHAR(200),
    VSORRES VARCHAR(200),
    VSORRESU VARCHAR(200),
    VISITNUM VARCHAR(200),
    VISIT VARCHAR(200),
    VSDTC VARCHAR(200),
    MODIFIED_TS VARCHAR(200)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(USUBJID),
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
);


SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VS;

--COPY DATA FROM ADLS
COPY INTO [dbo].[vs] 
FROM 'https://stsynapsedev1999.blob.core.windows.net/synapse-file/clintrail_data_files/VS/VS.csv'
WITH (
    FIELDTERMINATOR = ',',
    ROWTERMINATOR = '0x0A'
)
OPTION (LABEL = 'COPY: dbo.VS');

--SEE HOW IT DISTRIBUTED
DBCC PDW_SHOWSPACEUSED('dbo.VS')
